description: Search real dated train fares for a route, or re-read an earlier search. Results carry departures, arrivals, operators, durations and changes. Prices cover the requested adults, and returnOptions are separate one-way quotes. Pass searchId alone to filter or sort a search without asking the sellers again; pass searchId with journeyId for one fare's stored details. Start a fresh search when the route, date, currency or passenger count changes. A source failure does not mean no trains run. Never substitute a promotional from-price, a seller search page or a generic listing for an individual fare. Attach a fare with add_to_trip source 'train', this searchId and the unchanged journeyId. Stores fresh quotes under searchId for later refinement or attachment and retains an account-bound display result for 30 minutes. Does not reserve a seat, issue tickets or spend credits. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it. presentation (optional) shapes what is shown without changing the action: compact or full layout, and only the limit, ids or sections this tool advertises.

departAfter.description: Earliest outbound departure, HH:MM local, including the time it takes to reach the station

departDate.description: Outbound travel date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit only when refining with searchId.

destination.description: Where it ends, as a city or station name. Omit only when refining with searchId.

journeyId.description: With searchId: return the stored details of that one fare, exactly as it was quoted.

maxChanges.description: Most changes of train allowed on a journey; 0 means direct

maxTotalAmount.description: Whole-party one-way fare ceiling in integer minor units

origin.description: Where the journey starts, as a city or station name. Rail has no universal station codes. Omit only when refining with searchId.

passengers.description: Adult travelers; adult quotes never cover children

layout.description: Compact cards or the full view; keeps booking, add and error actions available.

returnDate.description: Explicit return travel date. Omit for one way; never repeat the outbound date.

returnDepartAfter.description: Earliest return departure, HH:MM local; needs returnDate

returnDepartBefore.description: Latest return departure, HH:MM local; needs returnDate

searchId.description: Refine an earlier search instead of asking the sellers again: the searchId it returned. Route, date, currency and passengers stay fixed.

sort.description: cheapest = lowest whole-party fare (default) | fastest = shortest journey | earliest = first departure

name: search_trains
title: Search trains
